title: The Ark Returned

questions.question: How long was the ark with the Philistines?
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 6:1 (ESV): “The ark of the Lord was in the country of the Philistines seven months.”

questions.question: What guilt offering was sent with the ark?
options: Five gold tumors and five gold mice
questions.correctAnswer: Five gold tumors and five gold mice
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 6:4 (ESV): “...‘Five golden tumors and five golden mice...’”

questions.question: How was the ark transported back?
options: On a new cart with two milk cows
questions.correctAnswer: On a new cart with two milk cows
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 6:7 (ESV): “Now then, take and prepare a new cart and two milk cows...”

questions.question: Where did the ark stop in Israel?
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 6:12 (ESV): “And the cows went straight... to Beth-shemesh...”

questions.question: Why specifically did the cows transporting the ark show it was God leading them?
options: They went straight, lowing as they went, and turned not aside, despite leaving their calves
questions.correctAnswer: They went straight, lowing as they went, and turned not aside, despite leaving their calves
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 6:12 (ESV): "And the cows went straight in the direction of Beth-shemesh... lowing as they went. They turned neither to the right nor to the left..." (Earlier verse mentions shutting up their calves at home).

questions.question: Who did the Philistines call to get advice on returning the ark?
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 6:2 (ESV): "And the Philistines called for the priests and the diviners and said, 'What shall we do with the ark of the LORD?'"

questions.question: Why did they include gold mice?
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 6:5 (ESV): "...images of your mice that ravage the land..."

questions.question: What happened to the cart and cows upon arrival?
options: They offered the cows as a burnt offering and used the cart for wood
questions.correctAnswer: They offered the cows as a burnt offering and used the cart for wood
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 6:14 (ESV): "...And they split up the wood of the cart and offered the cows as a burnt offering to the LORD."

questions.question: Why were men of Beth-shemesh struck down?
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 6:19 (ESV): "And he struck some of the men of Beth-shemesh, because they looked upon the ark of the LORD..."

questions.question: Who did the people of Beth-shemesh send messengers to?
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 6:21 (ESV): "So they sent messengers to the inhabitants of Kiriath-jearim..."

questions.question: How many men looked into the ark and died (in various translations, usually 70 or 50,070)?
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 6:19 (ESV): "...He struck seventy men of them..." (Some manuscripts say 50,070, but ESV uses 70).

questions.question: In whose field did the cart stop?
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 6:14 (ESV): "The cart came into the field of Joshua of Beth-shemesh and stopped there."

questions.question: What historical example did the priests cite to warn against hardening their hearts?
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 6:6 (ESV): "Why should you harden your hearts as the Egyptians and Pharaoh hardened their hearts?"

questions.question: Who took the ark down from the cart?
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 6:15 (ESV): "And the Levites took down the ark of the LORD..."

questions.question: What large stone represents the stopping place?
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 6:18 (ESV): "...The great stone beside which they set down the ark of the LORD is a witness to this day..."

key_verse_text: Then the men of Beth-shemesh said, “Who is able to stand before the LORD, this holy God? And to whom shall he go up away from us?” (ESV)
